# Nabaperks

> No-app QR loyalty for UK food & drink venues. Customers scan one permanent venue QR, a loyalty card opens in their phone browser (no app and no Apple/Google Wallet pass to install), they save it in one tap, and collect server-checked stamps. Reach the threshold and they unlock a reward redeemed in-store. Built for cafes, takeaways, casual restaurants, pubs and dessert shops.

## What makes Nabaperks different
- A true browser card, not a wallet pass: nothing to download or install, on any iPhone or Android. Rivals that say "no app" still require an Apple/Google Wallet pass.
- The Counter-Verified Stamp: every stamp is checked on the server against the physical venue QR, the customer's membership, the venue's billing status, a one-stamp-per-customer-per-UK-calendar-date cap, and optional GPS-anomaly signals. Rewards are verified live at redemption, not from a screenshot. The phone never crosses the counter.
- No POS and no hardware: works on any phone, tablet or till, including cash-only takeaways. A printed QR kit (poster, till card, sticker) is posted to the venue.
- Loyalty and marketing kept separate: customers can earn and redeem without joining a marketing list (UK GDPR soft opt-in).

## Pricing
- 30-day free pilot, then £29/month per venue (GBP). No contract.
- Build the card and preview the QR flow for free; billing starts only when the live venue QR is activated.
